title: Filters above UnionAll miss branch-local access-path optimization.

proposal_metadata.rationale: Distribute proven total primitive predicates to UnionAll inputs before access-path rules; rebind by IU mapping with exact input/output types and fresh operators.
proposal_metadata.limits: Decline partially pushed filters, unresolved subplans, volatile/fallible/unknown callables and optional-widening edges. Does not duplicate arbitrary residual expressions.
proposal_metadata.validation: Plan-level branch ranges, indexes and OLAP filtering; independent row bag and ordered-union checks; volatile/error/unknown-type/correlated/shared-producer controls.

independent_source_review.notes: Confirmed public PartiallyPushedDown and mapping APIs. Exact input/output types avoid optional-widening substitution; total callable whitelist excludes volatile, UDF and fallible expressions. Restored separate doccomments. Requires native and plan checks.

verification_limitation: Source preparation only; compilation, native semantics and optimization evidence still required.
